world.title: Trump China Visit Live: Trump meets Xi inside secretive compound in rare diplomatic gesture
world.description: Trump in China Live Updates: The summit between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping in Beijing revealed both strategic convergence and underlying friction in US-China ties. Trump sought to reinterpret Xi’s earlier remarks about American decline as criticism of the Joe Biden administration rather than the current US, using the moment to contrast his leadership with his predecessor’s. The two leaders found limited common ground on global security, particularly on keeping the Strait of Hormuz open and preventing Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons, suggesting both sides want stability in energy flows despite broader rivalry. At the same time, offstage incidents exposed tensions beneath the diplomatic choreography. Clashes involving reporters, security staff and officials highlighted Beijing’s strict controls over access and messaging. The optics of an all-male negotiating table also drew criticism, underscoring how symbolism became part of the summit narrative. Trump’s inclusion of executives such as Elon Musk and Jensen Huang signalled the centrality of trade and technology to the talks. Stay tuned to IndiaToday.in for the latest updates.

science.title: Scientists “bottle the sun” with a liquid battery that stores solar energy
science.description: Scientists at UC Santa Barbara have created a remarkable new material that works like a “rechargeable solar battery,” storing sunlight inside tiny molecules and releasing it later as heat — even long after the sun goes down. Inspired by reversible changes found in DNA and photochromic sunglasses, the system captures solar energy without relying on bulky batteries or the electrical grid. The molecule can hold energy for years and packs more energy per kilogram than lithium-ion batteries.
